profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Elastic | Billing & Monetization Platforms | Python · PostgreSQL · AWS Glue | Usage-Based Metering, Invoicing, and Payment Integrations (Stripe • Recurly)
profile.summary:
I’m a backend/platform engineer with strong Python expertise who specializes in revenue-critical systems where reliability and financial correctness are non-negotiable.

At Elastic, I work on distributed billing, monetization, and usage infrastructure. My work has spanned payment-provider integrations, usage metering, webhook platforms, large-scale billing migrations, financial-system modernization, and safely retiring legacy infrastructure.

What I bring to a team:
• Calm, practical engineering judgment in systems where mistakes have real consequences.
• Cross-functional credibility and technical leadership.
• A strong sense of ownership of the systems I touch. 
• The desire to improve the people and systems around me.

What I want from my team:
• High trust, strong peers, and low ego.
• Meaningful ownership of bounded, business-critical systems.
• A sustainable engineering culture where reliability, thoughtful decisions, and long-term maintainability matter more than constant urgency.

I’m looking for consequential problems, smart people, and an environment where good engineering judgment is still highly valued!

Primary Stack: Python, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, AWS (Glue, Lambda, S3, SNS), Docker, Linux, Git

Remote-first only. Not open to relocation or commuting.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform Billing
positions.description:
- Recouped over $1M in annually lost revenue by leading a cross-org billing initiative (EPP4*) end-to-end, breaking work into phased milestones and aligning stakeholders in Engineering, Product, IT, and Finance
- Delivered a usage aggregation and deduplication pipeline reducing stored data volume by 99.99997%, materially lowering infrastructure cost while preserving auditability and financial correctness
- Improved billing incident response by redesigning impact analysis tooling, reducing our MTTR during revenue-impacting incidents by over 90%.
- Built Recurly webhook processing from the ground up: event schema, signature verification, time-based cutoffs/timeouts, stale-event acking, plus Vault/Helm config, dedicated availability & latency SLOs, and on-call runbooks.
- Improved reliability and security of billing services: async PG connection-pool tuning and metrics, recurring CVE remediation (Flyway, boto, urllib), and Postgres-event synthetics monitors.
- Mentored engineers through onboarding, promotion preparation, and technical growth
- Regularly interviewed senior candidates and contributed to team culture and inclusivity initiatives.

EPP4* - Built a payment-provider integration to Stripe end-to-end, including webhook ingestion with signature verification, customer/setup-intent flows, and PDF invoice + dunning email generation. When strategy shifted to Recurly, I led its clean, phased decommission (removing the sub-app, secrets, and schema with zero production incidents) and drove the follow-up Recurly-v2 migration by reworking invoice PDF generation, refund logic, tax-notification comms, and email templates behind feature flags, before safely rolling them out from QA → staging → prod.
positions.insights: AWS Glue, Billing Systems and +8 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Platform Billing
positions.description:
- Implement features and execute on the roadmap for the Billing area of the Cloud. This includes working on the parts of the codebase that bring in monthly subscription revenue from thousands of Elasticsearch Service users
- Build scalable solutions and expose them via elegant REST APIs to deliver the best payments experience for the Elasticsearch Service
- Add features to the backend services in Python that uses Elasticsearch
- Collaborate with other Elastic engineering teams to develop scalable, automated solutions that drive our SaaS business
- Use Elasticsearch and Kibana to aggregate data for billing and usage reporting purposes
- Participate in the operation of an always-on service, maintaining a high level of observability

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Content Creation
positions.description:
- Re-architected a legacy RSS feed processing system, decomposing a monolithic, cron-driven Python 2
workflow into a scalable, multi-service architecture with improved concurrency controls and modern
observability, resolving long-standing memory leaks and significantly improving platform reliability.
- Led the decomposition of a monolithic Python 2 phone automation workflow into an event-driven
architecture, coordinating with billing systems to emit overdue-customer events and enabling reliable,
timezone-aware outbound calling with improved operational visibility.
- Develop and support HTTP services and AMQP consumers for products related to Customer Content Creation
- Modernize apps and cron jobs from Python2/PHP/Perl to Python3 and deploy them as Docker containers to Kubernetes or as Rundeck Jobs
- Create and update documentation, alerts, and application dashboards.
- Setup CI pipelines and Monitor servers and services with Grafana, Loggly, and Sensu

positions.title: Software Engineer - Platform Support
positions.description:
Focused on the health and availability of internal services and applications used by all company personnel. Frequently collaborated with other product teams and customer service to design and deliver high quality solutions and features.

Maintained and developed the internal admin app (adding new features and updating legacy CakePHP codebase)
Modernized services from Python 2 to Python 3 and deployed them onto Kubernetes nodes
Implemented event-driven designs using RabbitMQ with Grafana for data visualization
Ported internal chatbot app to Python from Coffeescript and added new functionality

positions.description:

honors.title: Elastic Engineering Monthly Award
honors.description:
Recipients were nominated and voted for by their peers, with the selection decisions made by engineering leadership:

"Stephanie Harris's dedication and behind-the-scenes impact have been instrumental to our Platform Billing (PB) team's success. After transitioning to a new team within PB, she continued to champion the migration from our legacy billing engine to the Consumption Engine, an important step in modernizing our billing infrastructure, unlocking new business capabilities, and reducing our operational workload. Stephanie designed the conversion path for over 30,000 direct monthly credit-card organizations, representing ~$6M in monthly revenue. She carefully curated organization cohorts and managed a controlled production drip to safeguard Monetizer and our billing systems throughout the migration. She also coordinated after-hours engineering support and authored a runbook for future migrations, helping us seamlessly complete the ~5k-org cutover in time for the October 1st bill run. Thank you, Stephanie, for your technical leadership, and commitment to excellence!"

honors.title: Q4FY24 Finance IT & Ops Recognition - Partner Award
honors.description:
Recognizes team members in the Finance, IT, and Operations team who made exemplary contributions in the fourth quarter. They were nominated by peers, with the eventual selection decisions made collectively by Finance IT leadership.

Partner Award (to an individual from another team with whom we closely partnered)

Stephanie Harris (Engineering)
Stephanie has been a vital member of the Entity Phase 4 project.  As the key partner on our Engineering team, Stephanie has displayed dedication and expertise, playing a pivotal role in design, build, and testing.  Her proactive approach, problem-solving skills, and responsiveness have been an asset to the project team.
